title: Applied-Energistics-2 issue #9031: ME Storage Bus on Storage Controller showing double items

text: [issue by HyperColt14] ### Describe the bug So I've noticed a lot when using Functional Storage to store tons of resources that normally would fill my ME System. It would show double items, so if you have 1k items in a drawer and you connect a storage bus from AE2 to Storage Controller to see the contents inside the drawer, from inside the ME System it'll show 2k which can be annoying when trying to autocraft ### How to reproduce the bug If you make any resource generation (im doing atm10 currently) im tryna craft omega upgrades. Link any drawer to the controller, then add a storage bus so the me system can see those external contents inside the drawer. If you try to autocraft lets say 100 Draconic Chunks it says you'll have enough but then it'll say you need an extra amount. My guess is that the ME System is thinking it needs more when it already has enough to craft ### Expected behavior All the items should be a 1:1 from the drawer and me storage bus but not like a 2:1 if the ratio is correct. Meaning if the drawer shows lets say 1k items, then the me system should also see it as 1k especially when trying to autocraft not 1k items in draw and system says it needs 2k to start crafting ### Additional details _No response_ ### Which minecraft version are you using? 1.21 ### On which mod loaders does it happen? NeoForge ### Crash log This doesn't cause a crash [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] The easiest mistake to make here is a second storage bus in the controller or the drawer itself. [comment by HyperColt14 (none)] Added another, but it didnt work [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] The point is that you should not have a second storage bus on an inventory you already see once. So you'd have to check If you have a second storage bus somewhere and removed it. [comment by HyperColt14 (none)] Checked my me's ui and it says there are 11, ik 4 of them are used to extract souls for soul surging and the rest are on controller access points [comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)] Is the drawer holding your Draconic Dust and Draconic Chunks by any chance a compacting drawer? Then this might mean you do not have enough Draconic Dust yet. Compacting Drawers are famous for reporting items twice (once all the Dusts that would be extractable and once all the Chunks that could be formed from the Dusts). There is no good solution for that. Try switching from compacing drawers to regular drawers. Make a crafting recipe for the Dusts. Otherwise you could start to disconnect everything from your network except the one storage bus for the FS storage controller in question plus a ME terminal and compare the numbers on the ME Terminal with the drawers. If that checks out reconnect cables one by one and check after every connection. [comment by HyperColt14 (none)] Managed to fix it, i forgot there was one on my dimensional chest (controller access point linked to main controller) and the dim chest is connected to the laser miner on the moon [comment by HyperColt14 (none)] Thanks for the help, means a lot!!
